notes: The supplied corpus does not establish a universal maximum deployment lifetime or a rule allocating how much of a month-long record to retain. It does contain continuous-monitor procedures: temperature verification, turbidity maintenance and drift/fouling checks, and EPA deployment/recovery calibration and data qualification. Per-turn positive evidence supports these distinctions without inventing project criteria or importing external guidance. Expected to favor RAG for the supported explanations.
